correctness.rationale: For p=h'-alpha, q=g', Re p>|q| and p(0)=1-alpha>0, omega=q/p is analytic Schur with omega(0)=0. Schwarz gives |q(z)|<=|z||p(z)|. Parseval on |z|=rho yields mean J>=1-c^2*rho^2+(1-rho^2)*sum_{n>=1}|d_n|^2*rho^(2n). Radial integration gives lower area r^2-c^2*r^4/2 plus a strict positive weighted coefficient remainder. Equality for r>0 forces d_n=0 and Schwarz equality omega=e^{i theta} z; precisely quadratic shears. Caratheodory bounds on p+lambda q provide |d_n|+|e_n|<=2c and the sharp known upper area. Positive-area interpolation is achieved via scaled shears below r^2 and analytic Möbius family above r^2; at r=1 the analytic family makes every finite higher area and the endpoint infinite. Independently integrated 2*rho*(1-c^2*rho^2) to exactly r^2-c^2*r^4/2, with finite polynomial coefficient normalizations checked. Injectivity follows integrating derivative inequality along segments; strict derivative constraint holds for all given explicit maps.
